buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA: a) Firms registered with valid Telangana state labour department and having ESI, EPF registration in Telan gana state are only eligible for bidding. Firm should submit the proof of document. b) The supplier firm shall comply with all applicable labour laws, statutory regulations and Government of I ndia instructions in force during contract period. c) ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS: i) The firm shall provide uniform, ID card, safety shoes and any other safety personnel equipment required for the workers engaged under this contract. ii) The firm shall provide Insurance to all workers under this contract. iii) The firm shall pay the wages and all statutory payments on or before 7th of every month. iv) The firm shall not demand for amount/claim of reimbursement from OFMK for uniform, safety shoes, saf ety personnel equipment, ID card and any other expenses which is beyond the quoted rate. v) The PSD of the successful bidder would be forfeited if the firm violate any of the terms of the contract or if firm indulging in any undue practices of collecting money from the workers. vi) All other terms and conditions will be followed as per AVNL procurement manual (goods & services) - 2 024, version 2.0. vii) Approximate date for deployment of manpower is from 01.11.2026 viii) Firm should submit compliance sheet along with firm's sign and seal. . 2. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms.
